name: Tin
note: Peru (Minsur San Rafael), Bolivia (Huanuni, Vinto), Brazil (Rondônia).
uses: Solder for electronics is the largest use; tinplate, chemicals and alloys follow.
why_it_matters: Peru, Bolivia and Brazil are among the largest producers, and Chinese smelters are large buyers of concentrate; tin is on both critical lists.
uses_source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (annual; uses as summarised there) and the registry notes; curated text, no figures
